paragraphs: The Nasdaq enters the early outlook with a strong negative setup: the Nasdaq Score is -57/100. Consolidation Risk is 46/100 (Moderate).

Nasdaq internals reinforce the cautious setup (semiconductors mixed, mega-caps negative, breadth negative).
